┌─ New character ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Make a character: a name and a class.                                        │
│                                                                              │
│ Name   _                   3 to 16 letters                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ Class (the server's menu)                                                    │
│ > 1  Warrior   tank                                                          │
│   2  Cleric    healer                                                        │
│   3  Rogue     melee                                                         │
│   4  Wizard    spell                                                         │
│   5  Paladin   tank + healer                                                 │
│   6  Druid     healer + spell                                                │
│                                                                              │
│ Armored front-liner who holds enemies' attention and soaks up their blows.   │
│ Starts with, free:                                                           │
│   Taunt (instant, cd 12s, range 20m, enemy)                                  │
│   Bash (instant, cd 18s, range 2m, enemy)                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Type the name. Tab or Down moves to the classes: Up / Down or 1-6 choose.    │
│ Enter makes the character and plays it. Ctrl+C quits.                        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
